title: Text over B-roll
one_liner: Calm everyday footage, slowed and warm-graded, with one lowercase line written like a text to a friend.
best_for: Camera-shy members, busy days and relatable one-liners: no talking, no captions, no sound effects.

palette.use: the text, the only colour you add (the footage brings the rest)

pace: 8-12 s (the demo build was 8.1 s), 3 clips slowed to 0.5-0.6x, one line per clip on its cut, hard cuts, loops cleanly
signature_moves: Each line arrives word by word with a soft blur on its clip's cut; earlier lines stay, so the text reads like a thread
Warm film grade on every clip (Film Memory: vintage wash, lifted blacks, grain) with a barely-there gate weave
The last frame matches the first, so the reel loops without a seam
